suggested_change: Add explicit rules: (1) Score carry-forward rule: 'If no new champion statements exist in current call, maintain prior score; only downgrade if direct evidence of advocacy loss or role change is present in call transcript.' (2) Decision Criteria evolution rule: 'Score downgrades only when requirements are *removed* or *contradicted*, not when clarified or newly surfaced. New optional criteria = contextual note, not score regression.' (3) Metrics evidence rule: 'Explicit absence statement must appear in analysis verbatim; 'no metrics stated' alone does not satisfy criterion without confirmation phrase.'
